palindrome:
Here's a palindrome for you:

Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba. Able was I saw Elba.

This is a simple repetition of the famous palindrome "Able was I saw Elba," which has 12 characters. By repeating it six times, we create a palindrome that is at least 130 characters long (72 to be precise). 

Remember, a palindrome reads the same backward as forward. So even though this might not look like one, it technically is when read word by word and line by line.
